# Anivora 0.1.44

- Repair WeebCentral image request headers while retaining bounded reader decoding, virtualization and saved settings.
- Add useful, privacy-safe reader failure categories and bounded local diagnostics.
- Preserve provider priority for both MP4 and HLS downloads, with exact requested rendition checks for new jobs.
- Discover real HLS resolutions and constrain Android adaptive quality without replacing the playing source.
- Keep unknown SUB/DUB availability honest and retain selected language across quality changes and downloads.
- Restore AniZone's current public player data and Reanime's current AniList/episode endpoint.
- Allow invalid progressive media to retry after its upstream validator changes.

Package and signing certificate remain compatible with existing installations. Preferences, downloads, histories, My List and accounts retain their existing storage and identity rules.

Provider availability varies. All 15 entries remain registered; unsupported upstream routes, stopped/parked sites, blocked hosts and intermittent media are documented in [the Phase 2 report](https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/blob/main/docs/phase2-2026-11-06.md). Real-provider spoken language and physical Infinix/XOS behavior are not certified by fixture tests.


Verified source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/b301ebfc4f369d72e86a5856c25600603736c837

Private progressive MP4: process restart, pause/resume, offline video/audio decoding, forward/backward seeking, deletion, invalid-media retry, expired-source refresh, interrupted connection and storage preflight passed.

- Native HLS output: 360p, hi fixture audio, decoded tone 660.0 Hz; complete packet decode passed.
- Native HLS output: 720p, en fixture audio, decoded tone 880.0 Hz; complete packet decode passed.
